newsitem.title: USA: Rubin--CPI data "very good," inflation low.
newsitem.headline: Rubin--CPI data "very good," inflation low.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin Friday called August consumer price data "very good" and said the economy was enjoying solid growth with low inflation.
"Basically we've been on a good track," he told reporters before a speech to the Congressional Black Caucus.
The Labor Department reported on Friday that consumer prices rose 0.1 percent in August.
"The economy is continuing the solid growth we've had," Rubin said.
"If you speak to business people, which I do a lot of, around the country, you do not see signs of reigniting inflation," he added.
